site.title: 🦉 Bubo Reader
site.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/158.0.8127.18 Safari/537.36
site.domainNote: self-hosted static RSS/Atom feed aggregator (Bubo Reader) grouping followed feeds by category

view.name: Feeds expanded
view.description: The feed page with two feed disclosures opened, showing dated lists of linked article titles under each feed.

regions.label: Page title '🦉 Bubo Reader' as plain h1, no navigation
Category h2 sections (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects) each holding collapsible <details> per feed source with dated article link lists
'Errors' section listing feeds that failed to fetch/parse
Horizontal rule, last-updated timestamp and 'Powered by Bubo Reader' credits with sponsor link

evidence.note: Native <details> open by default showing article list; triangle indicator
Collapsed sibling feeds; clicking WebKit on live page expanded it while Changelog stayed open (many at a time)
Second open section in a different category

evidence.quote: 11/15/2026 - Changelog & Friends 118: Kaizen! The one with the new CDN
evidence.note: Date + headline link items, newest first, from subscribed RSS feeds; grouped per source rather than merged into one stream

patterns.rationale: It is an RSS reader showing chronological headline items from followed sources, but items are split per-source inside collapsible groups rather than one merged stream, and the page is a static build with no loading behaviour.

evidence.quote: There were errors trying to parse these feeds:
evidence.note: Persistent error summary listing failed feeds; unstyled, sits as a normal section at the bottom

patterns.rationale: Functions as a persistent error notice about failed feeds, but has no banner styling (no color, container or icon) and reads as an ordinary content section.

evidence.note: Categories are static h2 headings; only one level of disclosure (feed -> articles), better coded as accordion
Article links go to external sites; no in-app detail view

structure.layout: single-column unstyled HTML document: h1 title, category h2 sections of native <details> feed groups with bulleted dated link lists, error list, hr and footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout at browser defaults: bold headings, regular body, default underlined blue links; feed URLs in gray
aesthetics.typeScale: h1 36px bold, h2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular; hierarchy from size/weight only

notes: Essentially browser-default HTML (no custom CSS beyond gray #aaaaaa feed URLs and 18px system-ui): default 8px body margin, default blue #0000ee underlined links, native disclosure triangles for <details>. Each list item is 'M/D/YYYY - <linked title>'. Only emoji (🦉 in title, ❤️ in footer) provide any visual flourish. Error section shows raw parser/fetch error strings. Footer has <hr>, 'Last updated' timestamp from static build and powered-by credits.
